entries.title: Claude crewmates on a computer that runs your work keep their conversation after the move to Infinitary
entries.body: When Infinitary moves saved work out of Firstmate 3000's folder, it brings each Claude crewmate's conversation along. It left out the crewmates working on a computer that runs your work, so after the move they could lose their place in their conversation. Now their conversations come along too.
entries.noPicture: The change is in which conversations the move brings along; no screen changes.
